dataset.name: Synthetic Patient Risk
dataset.description: Fictional patient records with direct identifiers (name, e-mail, phone, national ID), quasi-identifiers (age, ZIP, gender, city) and a binary cardiovascular-risk label.

privacy.guarantee: (ε, δ)-DP, example-level, add/remove adjacency, central model

accountant_info.name: Rényi DP (RDP)
accountant_info.reference: Mironov, 'Rényi Differential Privacy', CSF 2017; Mironov, Talwar, Zhang, 'Rényi DP of the Sampled Gaussian Mechanism', 2019
accountant_info.rigour: Rigorous upper bound on epsilon (conversion from RDP is slightly loose).

assumptions: Preprocessing statistics (means, std devs, category lists) are treated as public.
Hyperparameter tuning across multiple runs is not accounted for.
Each individual contributes exactly one row.
Without secure_mode, noise uses a non-cryptographic PRNG (fine for research, not for deployment).
